changes.problem: Success/error models allowed arbitrary CIP status and result byte lengths.
changes.resolution: Success general_status is fixed 0, the declared error is fixed 0x14; result length is exactly 2 or 0 respectively.

changes.problem: The EPATH range and tree suggested an arbitrary repeat of 8-bit logical segments.
changes.resolution: Declare exactly three class/instance/attribute logical values 1/1/1, permit their supported padded 8/16/32-bit encodings, and align CIP/path word ranges.

changes.problem: Session, length and CPF data-length ranges were much wider than the bounded declared model.
changes.resolution: Require nonzero registered sessions and align per-message derived length/default/ranges with the retained complete examples and bounded CIP payload.

changes.problem: Response context fields were labelled fuzzable although checked against a pending request.
changes.resolution: Mark response Sender Context runtime_bound under its existing explicit correlation dependency.

changes.problem: Some excluded services, hardcoded codec rules and nonexecuted external preconditions were implicit.
changes.resolution: Name every declared service/error, the external ForwardOpen boundary and runtime/generic limitations; do not turn notes/actions into executable claims.

codec_constraints.constraint: RegisterSession command 0x0065, zero request session, protocol version 1/options 0; success is not implied by sending it.
UnregisterSession command 0x0066 with bound nonzero registered handle; no payload or response.
Successful RegisterSession command 0x0065, nonzero assigned handle, version 1/options 0 and echoed Sender Context.
SendRRData command 0x006f with NullAddress then UnconnectedData; service 0x0e, logical class=1/instance=1/attribute=1, no service request data.
SendRRData success service 0x8e, general status 0, optional bounded UInt16 additional-status words, exactly two Vendor-ID result bytes.
SendRRData service 0x8e, general status 0x14, optional bounded UInt16 additional-status words, no result bytes.
SendUnitData command 0x0070, ConnectedAddress/ConnectedData, UInt16 sequence followed by Identity Vendor-ID request; requires external successful ForwardOpen on this same session.
SendUnitData Identity Vendor-ID success with produced T-to-O connection ID, echoed UInt16 sequence/context and exactly two result bytes; connection IDs are externally provisioned.
RegisterSession status 0x69 header-only failure, no command-specific payload; Sender Context correlates to register.
SendRRData status 0x64 header-only failure, no CPF/CIP payload; Sender Context correlates to send_rr.

Encapsulation options/interface handle are zero, CPF has exactly two ordered items, data/item lengths count actual bytes. Connected timeout is zero. Derived fields describe and repair the declared bounded layouts.
Additional status consists of an even number of octets. The model limits it to 0..64 bytes/0..32 UInt16 words although the codec accepts at most 510 bytes.
A successful unexpired external ForwardOpen on this registered session must provide consumed/produced directional IDs. RegisterSession and placeholder values alone do not satisfy this prerequisite.
structure_model, guard/actions and dependency scope/when are descriptive metadata. Exact field location, service acceptance and runtime correlation still use the existing codec/runtime.

remaining_gaps.description: This is not all EtherNet/IP/CIP: only the listed Identity Vendor-ID services/errors; normative subscription-only ODVA volumes were not inspected.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Keep the explicit subset; add other services only with primary wire evidence, concrete fields, state/dependency rules and corresponding codec support.

remaining_gaps.description: The separate generic-wire inventory contains only register/register_response (2/10) and online=false.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Implement session-value binding plus CPF/CIP/EPATH and connected-session semantics, migrate all listed models and states, then validate natively; do not enable online or fix opaque service bytes as a substitute.

remaining_gaps.description: ForwardOpen/ForwardClose, externally initialized connection IDs, establishment/expiry enforcement and initial sequence provisioning are absent.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Supply a deliberate external provisioning interface or implement verified ForwardOpen/ForwardClose and lifetime handling before treating connected traffic as self-contained.

remaining_gaps.description: Guard/actions do not clear cached handles/connections or execute arbitrary conditions.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Implement explicit session/connection lifecycle handling in runtime and exercise fresh-session and invalid-session paths before claiming lifecycle completeness.

remaining_gaps.description: This reviewed source pair has no newly generated IR, native validation, seeds, target exchanges or method comparison evidence.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Prepare the reviewed pair with the existing compiler in a later execution-authorized step, regenerate model corpus, then separately verify controlled exchanges and fixed-budget method results.
